title: Mango Sticky Rice
subtitle: thai mango with sticky rice
excerpt: Mango sticky rice is a Thai dessert of sweet steamed glutinous rice soaked in warm coconut milk sauce and served alongside sliced ripe mango. It is simple, comforting, and naturally vegan. Serves 4.
sourceNotes: A Thai street food dessert eaten year-round but most popular during mango season from April to June. The combination of sweet coconut sauce and ripe mango is one of the most beloved desserts in Thai cuisine.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The rice can be made up to 2 hours ahead. Keep covered at room temperature. The mango should be sliced fresh just before serving.

glossaryTerms.definition: A short-grain sticky rice that becomes chewy and clumping when cooked. Also called sweet rice or waxy rice. It must be soaked before steaming.
The rich liquid pressed from grated coconut flesh. It is used here as a warm sweet sauce to soak and dress the rice.

Use the ripest mango you can find. The sweetness of the mango is what makes the dish. Unripe mango will not work here.

items.prepNote: glutinous/sticky rice, soaked in cold water overnight then drained

content.text: Soak the rice in cold water overnight or for at least 6 hours. Drain well.
Line a steamer basket with muslin or a clean tea towel. Spread the rice in an even layer. Steam over boiling water for 25 to 30 minutes until the rice is translucent and tender.
While the rice steams, warm the coconut milk and sugar in a saucepan over low heat. Stir until the sugar dissolves. Do not boil.
Transfer the hot rice to a bowl. Pour two thirds of the coconut sauce over it. Stir gently and cover. Leave for 10 minutes so the rice absorbs the sauce.
Serve the rice in mounds alongside the mango. Drizzle the remaining coconut sauce over the top.

attrs.problem: The rice is still hard after steaming.
attrs.solution: It was not soaked long enough. The rice needs at least 6 hours, ideally overnight. Soak again for a few hours and re-steam.

attrs.problem: The rice is too wet and mushy.
attrs.solution: The soaked rice was too wet before steaming. Drain it thoroughly and let it sit in the strainer for a few minutes before steaming.
Reduce the sugar by one tablespoon next time. A very ripe mango also adds sweetness, so account for that before adjusting.

content.text: Mango sticky rice is sold from street carts and market stalls across Thailand. It is most abundant during the Thai mango season in April and May. The dessert is simple but takes patience with the soaking and steaming steps. Short-grain glutinous rice is available in most Asian supermarkets.
